Overall, adapting to market changes, leveraging international growth opportunities, and investing in technology will be crucial for Stripe's sustained success in the coming years.

## Recommendations

To address the slowdown in branded checkout growth, which fell to 1% in Q4 2025 from 6% in Q4 2024 [16], stakeholders should consider strategies to enhance these offerings. This could involve improving user experience, integrating more payment options, or leveraging data analytics to personalize the checkout process for customers.

Additionally, with 57% of new companies joining Stripe in 2025 based outside the US [2], further expansion into emerging markets presents a significant opportunity to diversify revenue streams. Targeting regions with increasing digital payment adoption could mitigate risks associated with market saturation in North America and Europe, which together account for 90% of Stripe's revenue [10].

Investing in technology and strategic partnerships will be crucial for enhancing product offerings and customer experience. The acquisition of Orum in July 2025, which provides real-time payment orchestration and bank verification tools, exemplifies this approach [9]. Continued investment in such technologies can streamline operations, improve transaction speeds, and ultimately drive customer satisfaction and retention.

By focusing on these recommendations, Stripe can better position itself to sustain growth and adapt to the evolving market landscape.
